harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Converted the staged Latin-1 filenames on node1 to UTF-8 under converted/, preserved imported/, and retained the existing plain.txt destination. Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22 remain unchanged. Restart persistence was verified.
actions_performed: Created converted/café.txt and converted/résumé.txt with byte-identical source contents.
Preserved the existing converted/plain.txt and recorded it as COLLISION_PRESERVED in conversion-report.txt.
Verified all destination filenames are valid UTF-8 and all expected files are present.
Safely restarted node1 and verified its boot identity changed from 9494a33b-f07f-4f2f-bb02-ec630ff93280 to 8736531a-5bed-4ef6-b3dc-04852678c5c1.

evidence.requirement: Convert Latin-1 filenames to UTF-8 while retaining contents and directory structure
evidence.summary: Byte-level listings show Latin-1 source bytes e9 becoming UTF-8 c3a9. Matching SHA-256 hashes prove café.txt and résumé.txt retained their contents.
The original plain.txt, café.txt, and résumé.txt remain under imported/ after conversion and restart.

evidence.requirement: Report collisions without overwriting or dropping the source
evidence.summary: The initially existing converted/plain.txt remains distinct from imported/plain.txt and conversion-report.txt records COLLISION_PRESERVED with missing=0.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and Linux 2.6.22-14-generic remained installed; only bundled Perl modules were used.

Evidence captures the healthy baseline and old boot ID, safe restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered SSH, mounted storage, filenames, hashes, UTF-8 validity, source tree, and collision report.
